oneOf.description: Knowledge scoped by an education system such as a country, state, or district (e.g. Hungary, Illinois/IM, Berlin)
Knowledge scoped by institution or organization (e.g. Artist School xy, Einstein-Gymnasium)

Knowledge scoped by an account, which can be either an individual user account (single person or team – typically educator(s) in charge, e.g. Márta Vitális) or an enterprise account (school or organization)

Knowledge scoped by a group of students. This could be an entire class or course (e.g. My 7b, GK 11/2) or an individual or sub-group of individuals (e.g. Francesca, Ahmed+Selcuk, the 3 musketeer girls)
